summary:
Incomplete review: 1 of 9 checks could not be completed (Writing Style). The findings below cover only the checks that ran, so no overall score or assessment is given.

The proposal has a defined problem, motivation, objectives, and architecture, but it requires substantial revision before submission. The missing Abstract is a critical completeness issue, while the Introduction structure, problem-solution separation, and objective formulation need major attention; Figure 2 also needs a more informative caption.

findings.title: Missing Abstract section
findings.description: The proposal does not contain the required Abstract section. Add an abstract of approximately one-third to one-half page summarizing the problem, motivation, proposed solution, and objectives.

findings.title: Introduction lacks text before its first subsection
findings.description: Section 1 (Introduction) jumps directly from the chapter heading to subsection 1.1 without introductory prose. Add a short paragraph introducing the purpose and scope of the Introduction before the first subsection.

findings.title: Problem section presents a solution
findings.description: The Problem section proposes a concrete solution instead of restricting itself to the problem and its consequences. Remove this sentence from the Problem section or move the proposed platform to the Motivation/Objectives section.

locations.quote: A **self-service platform that arms the workflow engine of Keycloak with an expiry date at grant time would end this accumulation**.

findings.title: Objective heading contains double verbs
findings.description: The second objective heading uses two coordinated action verbs. Split it into separate objectives or choose one primary verb, for example, “Implement connectors with expiry” or “Specify a connector framework with expiry.”

findings.title: Figure 2 caption is not sufficiently informative
findings.description: Figure 2 has a short, generic caption that does not explain the components, interfaces, data flows, or external systems shown. Replace it with a self-contained caption describing the architecture and the role of the principal components and integrations.

locations.section: Objective — Design and Implement Connectors with Expiry
